# YM49: 若帆之阁 Ruofan zhi Ge

Wave 2 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM49` · Page: `/scenes/#YM49` · Row: `research/buildings/YM49-ruofan-zhi-ge/`

## What it was

若帆之阁 Ruofan zhi Ge, north-east of 北远山村 across a stone bridge and west: 湛虚翠轩, 耕云堂, then 若帆之阁, with a 关帝庙 some tens of paces east of 湛虚翠轩 (S05 j82:6a). The tower had two plaques, 御风泠然 below and 平临天境 above (S05 j82:6a-b), so two storeys. Begun 1764 inside the great north gate; S361 names the square two-storey three-bay tower 安止楼, a half-in-water pavilion 碧澜亭, 耕云堂 on a rockery and 爽籁居; 耕云堂 survived 1860 and was lost around 1900 (E2337).

From the inventory row: **built** 1764; **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S43, S01, S337, S361).
